meta.title: Vendor IP Capture: refused for a user without the Compliance Officer role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Compliance Officer role on an Enterprise tenant.
Use Vendor IP Capture and assert that the non-Compliance Officer is refused or does not see it.
Repeat the action as a Compliance Officer and assert that it is available.
Compare the two role outcomes and record tenant RBAC configuration if access is granted to additional roles.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Compliance Officer role on an Enterprise tenant.; Use Vendor IP Capture and assert that the non-Compliance Officer is refused or does not see it.; Repeat the action as a Compliance Officer and assert that it is available.; Compare the two role outcomes and record tenant RBAC configuration if access is granted to additional roles.

steps.note: Open an existing event as the closest available route to event actions.
Explore Settings controls for any Vendor IP Capture action and record whether it is present, disabled, or opens a refusal.

args.need: sign in as the non-Compliance Officer user and the Compliance Officer on the Enterprise tenant, then compare whether Vendor IP Capture is refused or available for each role
